contentPattern.structure: image + category tag + headline + date per slide

suitableFor: light-background horizontal card carousels with category tag + headline + date
notSuitableFor: dark category tile carousels with CTA buttons

usage.reuseNote: application-concept-detail (high-protein-brownie-mix): Reused for the Related Concept teaser carousel (photo + headline + short description, prev/next arrows). | ingredient-listing (specialty/probiotics): Reused for both tabbed product-card grids (.tileListing__card - SureStart LactoB/BifidoB and LactoB/BifidoB HN019). The carousel-news parser's TILE_ITEM_SELECTOR already handles .tileListing__card, so the product tiles flatten into carousel-news blocks; the source tabs are flattened to headings. Parser->block contract governs reuse over the generic 'news' purpose label.
